description: This file defines the Fixer controller class for Opencart's currency extension, handling currency data fetching and saving via the Fixer API, including configuration and currency conversion logic.

classes.name: Fixer
classes.description: Controller class for managing currency exchange rate updates via the Fixer.io API within the Opencart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles displaying the currency fixer configuration page, loads language, sets breadcrumbs, and prepares view data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes saving of the Fixer API configuration, validating permissions and input, updating settings.

methods.name: currency
methods.description: Fetches latest currency rates from Fixer API, processes the data, updates currency values in the database, and clears the cache.
